title: mymind footer
description: A big white card with rounded top corners resting on a blurred wash of blush, tangerine, rose and lavender: the wordmark with an italic serif slogan, a soft grey 'how it works' box with a serif title, a stack of larger links, three columns of small-capital headings and rounded-sans links, and a hairline over a quiet legal row.
notes: the wash behind the card comes from accent, primary, chart-2 and chart-3
